P026 — Establish authoritative configuration identity and baselines
Property id

P026

Property name

Establish authoritative configuration identity and baselines

Historical origin

Defence/aerospace configuration management, MIL-STD-973, EIA-649 and ISO 10007.

Lineage class

CONFIGURATION_AND_INTERFACE_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Identify configuration items and establish approved product baselines.

Problem it addressed

Engineers reason about 'the system' while requirements, models, code, hardware, tests, data and environment refer to different versions.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Evidence is attributed to an indeterminate or non-reproducible configuration.

Mechanism

Assign stable identities to governed items and baselines; record composition, versions, authority, status and applicable environment; make evidence cite that identity.

Trigger or context

Multiple teams/suppliers; releases/builds; physical units; certification; long lifecycle; evidence reuse.

Non trigger or cheap path

For a small reversible prototype, an immutable build identifier, dependency lock and dated test record may suffice.

Dependencies or preconditions

Governed items, stable identifiers, change authority, status accounting and access to actual product/model/test/environment state.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Configuration must be tied to the authorised capability, commitments and operational population.

Authority preconditions

Authority to baseline, change, waive, release, roll back and supersede must be explicit and consequence-tiered.

Configuration or identity preconditions

This family centrally requires exact item/composition/version/environment/evidence identity.

Interface or integration preconditions

Interface and supplier configuration dependencies must be included in impact and release decisions.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Evidence must cite configuration and be invalidated or justified after change.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Evidence is attributed to an indeterminate or non-reproducible configuration. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Builder, integrator, release/change authority, verifier, operator, maintainer, supplier and auditor.

Known failure modes

Frozen-baseline bureaucracy; snapshot proliferation; approved-but-unimplemented changes; hidden environment drift; incomplete impact maps; evidence over/under-invalidation.

Important criticisms

Baselines can freeze learning, proliferate snapshots or create clerical work without improving reproducibility.

How the property evolved

Original form: Identify configuration items and establish approved product baselines. Evolved under criticism into: Identity sufficient to answer exactly what was decided, built, integrated, tested, delivered and operated—without mandating frozen documents.

Evolved form in this source

Identity sufficient to answer exactly what was decided, built, integrated, tested, delivered and operated—without mandating frozen documents.

Ceremony vs property

CCBs, forms and baseline reviews are optional. The property is truthful identity, authority, implementation status and evidence continuity.

P027 — Govern change authority, status and implementation
Property id

P027

Property name

Govern change authority, status and implementation

Historical origin

Configuration-management change control and status accounting.

Lineage class

CONFIGURATION_AND_INTERFACE_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Submit change requests to a configuration control board and record dispositions.

Problem it addressed

Unauthorised or partially implemented changes enter the system, or approved changes exist only on paper.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

The delivered/operated product diverges from the authorised technical definition.

Mechanism

Define who may approve which consequences; record proposal, analysis, decision, implementation status, exceptions and actual incorporation across affected configurations.

Trigger or context

Shared baselines; contractual commitments; multiple suppliers; costly/regulated changes.

Non trigger or cheap path

A single owner can approve and implement a low-risk change directly if identity and tests remain explicit.

Dependencies or preconditions

Governed items, stable identifiers, change authority, status accounting and access to actual product/model/test/environment state.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Configuration must be tied to the authorised capability, commitments and operational population.

Authority preconditions

Authority to baseline, change, waive, release, roll back and supersede must be explicit and consequence-tiered.

Configuration or identity preconditions

This family centrally requires exact item/composition/version/environment/evidence identity.

Interface or integration preconditions

Interface and supplier configuration dependencies must be included in impact and release decisions.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Evidence must cite configuration and be invalidated or justified after change.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: The delivered/operated product diverges from the authorised technical definition. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Builder, integrator, release/change authority, verifier, operator, maintainer, supplier and auditor.

Known failure modes

Frozen-baseline bureaucracy; snapshot proliferation; approved-but-unimplemented changes; hidden environment drift; incomplete impact maps; evidence over/under-invalidation.

Important criticisms

Boards can become slow gatekeepers, optimise paperwork and diffuse accountability; emergency paths can bypass analysis.

How the property evolved

Original form: Submit change requests to a configuration control board and record dispositions. Evolved under criticism into: Consequence-tiered authority and truthful status accounting; a standing board is optional.

Evolved form in this source

Consequence-tiered authority and truthful status accounting; a standing board is optional.

Ceremony vs property

CCBs, forms and baseline reviews are optional. The property is truthful identity, authority, implementation status and evidence continuity.

P028 — Propagate change impact across technical relationships
Property id

P028

Property name

Propagate change impact across technical relationships

Historical origin

Engineering-change propagation research and CM practice.

Lineage class

CONVERGENT_ENGINEERING

Tradition relation

CONVERGENT_PROPERTY

Original form

Assess affected configuration items before approving a change.

Problem it addressed

A small local edit has unrecognised consequences for requirements, interfaces, budgets, suppliers, tests, operations or public claims.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Change closes locally while dependent evidence remains green and stale.

Mechanism

Traverse current semantic dependencies; challenge assumptions and non-local interactions; classify certain, possible and unknown impacts; assign rework/revalidation owners.

Trigger or context

High coupling; shared resources; reused assets; safety/performance effects; cross-organisation changes.

Non trigger or cheap path

For a local isolated change, deterministic dependency analysis plus focused regression is the cheap path.

Dependencies or preconditions

Governed items, stable identifiers, change authority, status accounting and access to actual product/model/test/environment state.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Configuration must be tied to the authorised capability, commitments and operational population.

Authority preconditions

Authority to baseline, change, waive, release, roll back and supersede must be explicit and consequence-tiered.

Configuration or identity preconditions

This family centrally requires exact item/composition/version/environment/evidence identity.

Interface or integration preconditions

Interface and supplier configuration dependencies must be included in impact and release decisions.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Evidence must cite configuration and be invalidated or justified after change.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Change closes locally while dependent evidence remains green and stale. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Builder, integrator, release/change authority, verifier, operator, maintainer, supplier and auditor.

Known failure modes

Frozen-baseline bureaucracy; snapshot proliferation; approved-but-unimplemented changes; hidden environment drift; incomplete impact maps; evidence over/under-invalidation.

Important criticisms

Dependency maps are incomplete/stale; impact tools produce false positives; exhaustive traversal can exceed change value.

How the property evolved

Original form: Assess affected configuration items before approving a change. Evolved under criticism into: Evidence-bearing impact analysis that admits uncertainty and feeds implementation, integration and revalidation—not a form approval.

Evolved form in this source

Evidence-bearing impact analysis that admits uncertainty and feeds implementation, integration and revalidation—not a form approval.

Ceremony vs property

CCBs, forms and baseline reviews are optional. The property is truthful identity, authority, implementation status and evidence continuity.

P029 — Re-establish evidence currentness after change
Property id

P029

Property name

Re-establish evidence currentness after change

Historical origin

Configuration management, regression and model-credibility practice.

Lineage class

HYBRID

Tradition relation

HYBRID_RESOLUTION

Original form

Update affected documents and rerun required tests after approved changes.

Problem it addressed

Prior verification, validation, model credibility or acceptance evidence is reused after its configuration, assumptions or use context changed.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

A system appears assured because historical evidence remains marked complete.

Mechanism

Attach validity conditions and configuration identity to evidence; invalidate on relevant change; justify reuse; perform change-specific regression/revalidation and preserve residual limitations.

Trigger or context

Any claim carried across versions; certification; reused analyses/models; operational updates.

Non trigger or cheap path

No-op or provably irrelevant changes can retain evidence with a concise impact proof.

Dependencies or preconditions

Governed items, stable identifiers, change authority, status accounting and access to actual product/model/test/environment state.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Configuration must be tied to the authorised capability, commitments and operational population.

Authority preconditions

Authority to baseline, change, waive, release, roll back and supersede must be explicit and consequence-tiered.

Configuration or identity preconditions

This family centrally requires exact item/composition/version/environment/evidence identity.

Interface or integration preconditions

Interface and supplier configuration dependencies must be included in impact and release decisions.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Evidence must cite configuration and be invalidated or justified after change.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: A system appears assured because historical evidence remains marked complete. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Builder, integrator, release/change authority, verifier, operator, maintainer, supplier and auditor.

Known failure modes

Frozen-baseline bureaucracy; snapshot proliferation; approved-but-unimplemented changes; hidden environment drift; incomplete impact maps; evidence over/under-invalidation.

Important criticisms

Over-invalidation wastes effort; under-invalidation creates latent false assurance; impact proofs can be self-serving.

How the property evolved

Original form: Update affected documents and rerun required tests after approved changes. Evolved under criticism into: Evidence is a versioned claim with an applicability boundary and refresh rule, not a timeless attachment.

Evolved form in this source

Ceremony vs property

CCBs, forms and baseline reviews are optional. The property is truthful identity, authority, implementation status and evidence continuity.

P030 — Maintain parity among model, implementation, test, data and environment
Property id

P030

Property name

Maintain parity among model, implementation, test, data and environment

Historical origin

Configuration management translated into model-based/digital engineering.

Lineage class

MODEL_BASED_SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

MODEL_BASED_GENERALISATION

Original form

Keep engineering documents/models consistent with the product baseline.

Problem it addressed

The 'authoritative' model, executable system, tests, datasets, tool chain or operational environment describe different systems.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Analysis and review are correct for a representation that no longer governs reality.

Mechanism

Version and relate all decision-relevant representations; check transformations/conformance; expose permitted divergence and unresolved inconsistency; bind evidence to tooling/data.

Trigger or context

MBSE/digital thread; generated artefacts; AI/ML datasets; simulation; multi-tool programmes.

Non trigger or cheap path

For a compact code-centric system, source, dependency lock, tests and environment manifest may form the whole parity set.

Dependencies or preconditions

Governed items, stable identifiers, change authority, status accounting and access to actual product/model/test/environment state.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Configuration must be tied to the authorised capability, commitments and operational population.

Authority preconditions

Authority to baseline, change, waive, release, roll back and supersede must be explicit and consequence-tiered.

Configuration or identity preconditions

This family centrally requires exact item/composition/version/environment/evidence identity.

Interface or integration preconditions

Interface and supplier configuration dependencies must be included in impact and release decisions.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Evidence must cite configuration and be invalidated or justified after change.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Analysis and review are correct for a representation that no longer governs reality. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Builder, integrator, release/change authority, verifier, operator, maintainer, supplier and auditor.

Known failure modes

Frozen-baseline bureaucracy; snapshot proliferation; approved-but-unimplemented changes; hidden environment drift; incomplete impact maps; evidence over/under-invalidation.

Important criticisms

Strict global consistency can be infeasible; synchronisation can dominate engineering time; transformations may preserve syntax but not meaning.

How the property evolved

Original form: Keep engineering documents/models consistent with the product baseline. Evolved under criticism into: Governed representation parity with explicit, risk-bounded inconsistencies—never an unsupported claim that one repository equals reality.

Evolved form in this source

Governed representation parity with explicit, risk-bounded inconsistencies—never an unsupported claim that one repository equals reality.

Ceremony vs property

CCBs, forms and baseline reviews are optional. The property is truthful identity, authority, implementation status and evidence continuity.

P031 — Plan integration strategy, sequence and readiness
Property id

P031

Property name

Plan integration strategy, sequence and readiness

Historical origin

Aerospace/space programme integration and NASA lifecycle practice.

Lineage class

AEROSPACE_OR_DEFENCE_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Create an assembly, integration and test plan for bottom-up system realisation.

Problem it addressed

Products arrive in an order or maturity state that blocks useful integration, hides high-risk interfaces or consumes scarce facilities inefficiently.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

The first system-level composition occurs after architecture and supplier choices are hard to change.

Mechanism

Order integration by risk, dependency and learning value; define entry evidence, facilities, configurations, owners, fallback paths and anomaly flow.

Trigger or context

Multiple components/suppliers; scarce testbeds; hardware/software coupling; high integration risk.

Non trigger or cheap path

Two-component low-risk work may integrate directly under a short checklist.

Dependencies or preconditions

Defined interfaces/configurations, integration authority, suitable environments, entry evidence, anomaly process and feasible sequencing.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Integration must exercise the mission/use interactions that matter, not only convenient assembly paths.

Authority preconditions

Someone must control integration configuration, sequence, facilities, discrepancy disposition and stop/go decisions.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Every integration result must identify products, software/data, environment, tools and configuration.

Interface or integration preconditions

Risky semantic, timing, physical, organisational and state interfaces are first-class targets.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Integration evidence is not automatically verification or validation; claims, coverage and limitations must be stated.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: The first system-level composition occurs after architecture and supplier choices are hard to change. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Integration lead, architecture/interface owners, V&V authorities, release authority and operators.

Known failure modes

Late big-bang composition; low-fidelity surrogate overclaim; schedule-driven readiness waivers; anomaly closure theatre; component-pass/system-fail.

Important criticisms

Detailed plans become obsolete; readiness criteria can be gamed; schedule pressure encourages paper waivers.

How the property evolved

Original form: Create an assembly, integration and test plan for bottom-up system realisation. Evolved under criticism into: A living risk/learning strategy that determines what is combined next and why, rather than a date-driven final-assembly schedule.

Evolved form in this source

A living risk/learning strategy that determines what is combined next and why, rather than a date-driven final-assembly schedule.

Ceremony vs property

Integration plans and readiness reviews are optional carriers. The property is early enough, risk-ranked composition evidence.

Late 'big bang' integration reveals incompatible assumptions after local designs and contracts are entrenched.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Composition defects drive rework, delay and blame across organisational boundaries.

Mechanism

Create the earliest affordable compositions—physical, simulated, emulated or contractual—then increase fidelity and scope; prioritise interfaces and emergent behaviours.

Trigger or context

Novel interactions; distributed teams; change-prone software; high coupling; long supplier chains.

Non trigger or cheap path

Where physical integration is destructive or extraordinarily costly, use earlier models/fixtures and fewer evidence-rich physical events.

Dependencies or preconditions

Defined interfaces/configurations, integration authority, suitable environments, entry evidence, anomaly process and feasible sequencing.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Integration must exercise the mission/use interactions that matter, not only convenient assembly paths.

Authority preconditions

Someone must control integration configuration, sequence, facilities, discrepancy disposition and stop/go decisions.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Every integration result must identify products, software/data, environment, tools and configuration.

Interface or integration preconditions

Risky semantic, timing, physical, organisational and state interfaces are first-class targets.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Integration evidence is not automatically verification or validation; claims, coverage and limitations must be stated.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Composition defects drive rework, delay and blame across organisational boundaries. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Integration lead, architecture/interface owners, V&V authorities, release authority and operators.

Known failure modes

Late big-bang composition; low-fidelity surrogate overclaim; schedule-driven readiness waivers; anomaly closure theatre; component-pass/system-fail.

Important criticisms

Continuous integration rhetoric can ignore hardware lead times, unavailable environments and low-fidelity simulator error.

How the property evolved

Original form: Assemble the complete system after components pass lower-level verification. Evolved under criticism into: Integration cadence proportional to risk and reversibility, with escalating fidelity and truthful limits.

Evolved form in this source

Integration cadence proportional to risk and reversibility, with escalating fidelity and truthful limits.

Ceremony vs property

Integration plans and readiness reviews are optional carriers. The property is early enough, risk-ranked composition evidence.

P033 — Use credible integration environments, stubs, simulators and testbeds
Property id

P033

Property name

Use credible integration environments, stubs, simulators and testbeds

Historical origin

Aerospace simulation/testbed practice and modern model credibility.

Lineage class

AEROSPACE_OR_DEFENCE_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Use simulators and support equipment before full hardware is available.

Problem it addressed

A convenient surrogate conceals timing, physical, data or operational effects while being treated as equivalent to the real system.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Early integration passes and later high-fidelity integration fails.

Mechanism

Define surrogate purpose, fidelity, assumptions, interfaces, known omissions and correlation evidence; retire or upgrade when it no longer answers the decision.

Trigger or context

Unavailable/expensive components; hazardous tests; distributed delivery; autonomy; rare environments.

Non trigger or cheap path

Use real components directly where cheap and safe; do not build a simulator merely because the process expects one.

Dependencies or preconditions

Defined interfaces/configurations, integration authority, suitable environments, entry evidence, anomaly process and feasible sequencing.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Integration must exercise the mission/use interactions that matter, not only convenient assembly paths.

Authority preconditions

Someone must control integration configuration, sequence, facilities, discrepancy disposition and stop/go decisions.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Every integration result must identify products, software/data, environment, tools and configuration.

Interface or integration preconditions

Risky semantic, timing, physical, organisational and state interfaces are first-class targets.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Integration evidence is not automatically verification or validation; claims, coverage and limitations must be stated.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Early integration passes and later high-fidelity integration fails. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Integration lead, architecture/interface owners, V&V authorities, release authority and operators.

Known failure modes

Late big-bang composition; low-fidelity surrogate overclaim; schedule-driven readiness waivers; anomaly closure theatre; component-pass/system-fail.

Important criticisms

Simulator construction and maintenance can become a parallel system project; common-mode model error can mislead all teams.

How the property evolved

Original form: Use simulators and support equipment before full hardware is available. Evolved under criticism into: Decision-bounded integration surrogates with explicit credibility and migration to higher fidelity.

Evolved form in this source

Decision-bounded integration surrogates with explicit credibility and migration to higher fidelity.

Ceremony vs property

Integration plans and readiness reviews are optional carriers. The property is early enough, risk-ranked composition evidence.

P034 — Manage integration anomalies and regressions as system evidence
Property id

P034

Property name

Manage integration anomalies and regressions as system evidence

Historical origin

System test, discrepancy reporting and configuration-control traditions.

Lineage class

AEROSPACE_OR_DEFENCE_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Log integration discrepancies, assign corrective action and retest.

Problem it addressed

Anomalies are closed administratively, dismissed as test artefacts or fixed locally without checking systemic causes and regressions.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Contradictory evidence is normalised until an operational failure exposes it.

Mechanism

Preserve observations, exact configurations/environments, hypotheses, dispositions, waivers and regression scope; escalate unexplained contradictions.

Trigger or context

Complex integration; intermittent failures; safety/mission consequence; reused evidence; many configurations.

Non trigger or cheap path

A reproducible low-risk defect can be fixed and regression-tested without a formal board.

Dependencies or preconditions

Defined interfaces/configurations, integration authority, suitable environments, entry evidence, anomaly process and feasible sequencing.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Integration must exercise the mission/use interactions that matter, not only convenient assembly paths.

Authority preconditions

Someone must control integration configuration, sequence, facilities, discrepancy disposition and stop/go decisions.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Every integration result must identify products, software/data, environment, tools and configuration.

Interface or integration preconditions

Risky semantic, timing, physical, organisational and state interfaces are first-class targets.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Integration evidence is not automatically verification or validation; claims, coverage and limitations must be stated.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Contradictory evidence is normalised until an operational failure exposes it. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Integration lead, architecture/interface owners, V&V authorities, release authority and operators.

Known failure modes

Late big-bang composition; low-fidelity surrogate overclaim; schedule-driven readiness waivers; anomaly closure theatre; component-pass/system-fail.

Important criticisms

Queues and boards can delay obvious fixes; teams may game severity or classify away inconvenient evidence.

How the property evolved

Original form: Log integration discrepancies, assign corrective action and retest. Evolved under criticism into: Anomaly closure means explanatory and evidential resolution, not status colour change.

Evolved form in this source

Anomaly closure means explanatory and evidential resolution, not status colour change.

Ceremony vs property

Integration plans and readiness reviews are optional carriers. The property is early enough, risk-ranked composition evidence.

Manage integration anomalies and regressions as system evidence

Identified items

All representations/products/environments whose identity can change the claim or decision.

Baseline or current state

Authoritative current composition and supersession are explicit; a baseline is not presumed frozen forever.

Change authority

Someone must control integration configuration, sequence, facilities, discrepancy disposition and stop/go decisions.

Impact scope

Requirements, architecture, assumptions, interfaces, suppliers, models, code/hardware, tests, operations and claims as material.

Status accounting

Decision, implementation, rollout, exception and actual operational state are distinguished.

Evidence currentness

Evidence cites configuration and has invalidation/reuse rules.

Rollback or recovery

Required where change consequence and reversibility justify it.

Cheap path

A reproducible low-risk defect can be fixed and regression-tested without a formal board.

Mature form

Anomaly closure means explanatory and evidential resolution, not status colour change.

Integration profile
Property

Manage integration anomalies and regressions as system evidence

Integration objective

Expose the highest-value composition uncertainty early enough to change design/action.

Sequence

Risk-, dependency- and learning-ordered rather than merely schedule-ordered.

Entry identity

Exact component/model/software/data/environment versions and readiness evidence.

Environment or surrogate

Fidelity, intended use, omissions and correlation are explicit.

Semantic, timing, state, physical, organisational and failure interactions.

Regression

Verification validation profile
Property

Manage integration anomalies and regressions as system evidence

Claim

A specific requirement, architecture/interface proposition, model-use claim, mission/use claim or change-equivalence claim.

Verification question

Does the identified configuration satisfy the specified claim?

Validation question

Does it fulfil the current intended use/need in the relevant context?

Method

Test, analysis, inspection, demonstration, simulation, operational evidence or combination selected for discrimination and cost.

Environment and data

Representative enough for the claim; provenance, fidelity and limitations explicit.

Independence

Proportionate to consequence, producer incentives and claim uncertainty.

Coverage and limits

Coverage is stated but never equated with absence of unknown behaviour.

Anomalies

Contradictory and unresolved evidence remains visible.

Currentness

Bound to configuration, assumptions, intended use and change impact.

A reproducible low-risk defect can be fixed and regression-tested without a formal board.

P035 — Reason about emergent and whole-system interactions
Property id

P035

Property name

Reason about emergent and whole-system interactions

Historical origin

Systems thinking, complex-systems and SoS research.

Lineage class

HYBRID

Tradition relation

HYBRID_RESOLUTION

Original form

Analyse system behaviour by composing subsystem functions.

Problem it addressed

Interactions, feedback, adaptation and organisational response create behaviours not predictable from isolated component properties.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

All allocated requirements pass yet mission behaviour is unstable, unsafe or ineffective.

Mechanism

Identify feedback, modes, shared resources, nonlinearities, adaptation and plausible interaction paths; use simulation, scenario exploration, integration and operational monitoring.

Trigger or context

Complex adaptive systems; autonomy; dense coupling; SoS; humans in operation; uncertain environment.

Non trigger or cheap path

Do not invoke 'emergence' for every dependency: deterministic interface and resource checks should be exhausted first.

Dependencies or preconditions

Defined interfaces/configurations, integration authority, suitable environments, entry evidence, anomaly process and feasible sequencing.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Integration must exercise the mission/use interactions that matter, not only convenient assembly paths.

Authority preconditions

Someone must control integration configuration, sequence, facilities, discrepancy disposition and stop/go decisions.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Every integration result must identify products, software/data, environment, tools and configuration.

Interface or integration preconditions

Risky semantic, timing, physical, organisational and state interfaces are first-class targets.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Integration evidence is not automatically verification or validation; claims, coverage and limitations must be stated.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: All allocated requirements pass yet mission behaviour is unstable, unsafe or ineffective. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Integration lead, architecture/interface owners, V&V authorities, release authority and operators.

Known failure modes

Late big-bang composition; low-fidelity surrogate overclaim; schedule-driven readiness waivers; anomaly closure theatre; component-pass/system-fail.

Important criticisms

Emergence can become an excuse for poor specification or unfalsifiable modelling; exhaustive prediction is impossible.

How the property evolved

Original form: Analyse system behaviour by composing subsystem functions. Evolved under criticism into: Whole-system interaction hypotheses tied to testable evidence and boundaries, not vague complexity language.

Evolved form in this source

Whole-system interaction hypotheses tied to testable evidence and boundaries, not vague complexity language.

Ceremony vs property

Integration plans and readiness reviews are optional carriers. The property is early enough, risk-ranked composition evidence.

P036 — Distinguish verification from validation
Property id

P036

Property name

Distinguish verification from validation

Historical origin

Long-standing testing/quality distinctions codified in NASA, IEEE and lifecycle standards.

Lineage class

VERIFICATION_VALIDATION_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Verify conformance to specified requirements and validate satisfaction of intended use/needs.

Problem it addressed

Passing requirements is treated as proof that the right system was built, or user acceptance is treated as proof of every technical requirement.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

A conforming system fails its mission, or an attractive demonstration conceals technical nonconformance.

Mechanism

Maintain separate claims, authorities, contexts and evidence for specified correctness and use/mission fitness; connect but do not collapse them.

Trigger or context

Any consequential system; especially where requirements may be wrong, incomplete or stale.

Non trigger or cheap path

For tiny direct-user work, one feedback event may simultaneously inform both questions, but the two claims remain distinct.

Dependencies or preconditions

Explicit claims, authoritative baseline, fit-for-purpose environment/data, independent or competent evaluators and anomaly/limitation handling.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Validation claims require current intended use and representative stakeholders/operations.

Authority preconditions

Technical evidence authority, acceptance authority and need/mission authority must not be conflated.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Claim, item configuration, procedure/model/tool/data and environment must be fixed and recoverable.

Interface or integration preconditions

System and cross-boundary claims require composition evidence, not only component results.

Evidence or vv preconditions

The property itself requires explicit evidence adequacy, coverage, uncertainty, residual limitations and currentness.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: A conforming system fails its mission, or an attractive demonstration conceals technical nonconformance. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Verifier, validator, qualification/certification authority, acceptance authority, architecture/change authority and operator.

Known failure modes

Verifying the wrong baseline; unrepresentative environment; coverage-as-correctness; model reuse beyond validity; sign-off overclaim; ignored contradictory evidence.

Important criticisms

Terminology varies across domains; ritual definitions do not prevent teams from verifying the wrong baseline.

How the property evolved

Original form: Verify conformance to specified requirements and validate satisfaction of intended use/needs. Evolved under criticism into: Two explicit assurance questions with distinct evidence and consumers, applied iteratively across levels.

Evolved form in this source

Two explicit assurance questions with distinct evidence and consumers, applied iteratively across levels.

Ceremony vs property

Compliance matrices, test reports and V-model diagrams are optional. The property is bounded evidence for a specified claim and use.

P037 — Plan V&V and testability before implementation closes options
Property id

P037

Property name

Plan V&V and testability before implementation closes options

Historical origin

V/Vee lineages and modern early-V&V/continuous-testing practice.

Lineage class

VERIFICATION_VALIDATION_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Define verification methods and acceptance criteria alongside requirements.

Problem it addressed

A requirement or architecture cannot be credibly tested, observed or analysed after implementation choices are fixed.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Late test design reveals ambiguous claims, inaccessible states, missing instrumentation or unaffordable environments.

Mechanism

For each consequential claim, identify evidence method, environment, instrumentation, independence, data and pass/fail logic early; feed feasibility back into requirements/design.

Trigger or context

High test cost; hidden internal states; qualification environments; autonomy; supplier evidence.

Non trigger or cheap path

For straightforward observable behaviour, write the direct check at implementation time.

Dependencies or preconditions

Explicit claims, authoritative baseline, fit-for-purpose environment/data, independent or competent evaluators and anomaly/limitation handling.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Validation claims require current intended use and representative stakeholders/operations.

Authority preconditions

Technical evidence authority, acceptance authority and need/mission authority must not be conflated.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Claim, item configuration, procedure/model/tool/data and environment must be fixed and recoverable.

Interface or integration preconditions

System and cross-boundary claims require composition evidence, not only component results.

Evidence or vv preconditions

The property itself requires explicit evidence adequacy, coverage, uncertainty, residual limitations and currentness.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Late test design reveals ambiguous claims, inaccessible states, missing instrumentation or unaffordable environments. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Verifier, validator, qualification/certification authority, acceptance authority, architecture/change authority and operator.

Known failure modes

Verifying the wrong baseline; unrepresentative environment; coverage-as-correctness; model reuse beyond validity; sign-off overclaim; ignored contradictory evidence.

Important criticisms

Upfront V&V plans can freeze immature requirements and become stale; testability can distort useful design.

How the property evolved

Original form: Define verification methods and acceptance criteria alongside requirements. Evolved under criticism into: Early assurance design that changes requirements and architecture when evidence would otherwise be impossible or noncredible.

Evolved form in this source

Early assurance design that changes requirements and architecture when evidence would otherwise be impossible or noncredible.

Ceremony vs property

Compliance matrices, test reports and V-model diagrams are optional. The property is bounded evidence for a specified claim and use.

P038 — Select evidence methods fit to the claim and decision
Property id

P038

Property name

Select evidence methods fit to the claim and decision

Historical origin

Inspection/analysis/demonstration/test traditions in aerospace and current model-credibility guidance.

Lineage class

VERIFICATION_VALIDATION_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Assign a verification method to each requirement.

Problem it addressed

The cheapest or customary method is used even when it cannot discriminate the claim; conversely, expensive tests duplicate deterministic analysis.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

A verification matrix is complete but evidentially weak.

Mechanism

Match claim type, consequence, observability, uncertainty and environment to test, analysis, inspection, demonstration or combined evidence; justify substitutions and independence.

Trigger or context

Large requirement sets; hazardous/expensive testing; analytical certification; model-based evidence.

Non trigger or cheap path

Use the cheapest deterministic discriminator that genuinely settles the claim.

Dependencies or preconditions

Explicit claims, authoritative baseline, fit-for-purpose environment/data, independent or competent evaluators and anomaly/limitation handling.

Validation claims require current intended use and representative stakeholders/operations.

Claim, item configuration, procedure/model/tool/data and environment must be fixed and recoverable.

System and cross-boundary claims require composition evidence, not only component results.

Evidence or vv preconditions

The property itself requires explicit evidence adequacy, coverage, uncertainty, residual limitations and currentness.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: A verification matrix is complete but evidentially weak. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Verifier, validator, qualification/certification authority, acceptance authority, architecture/change authority and operator.

Known failure modes

Verifying the wrong baseline; unrepresentative environment; coverage-as-correctness; model reuse beyond validity; sign-off overclaim; ignored contradictory evidence.

Important criticisms

Analysis may inherit model assumptions; demonstrations are cherry-pickable; tests sample finite conditions; inspections check only observable attributes.

How the property evolved

Original form: Assign a verification method to each requirement. Evolved under criticism into: Claim-centred evidence design with explicit adequacy, limitations and residual uncertainty; no method hierarchy is universal.

Ceremony vs property

Compliance matrices, test reports and V-model diagrams are optional. The property is bounded evidence for a specified claim and use.

Property id

P039

Property name

Validate with real users, operations and mission context

Historical origin

Operational test, acceptance and human-systems integration traditions.

Lineage class

AEROSPACE_OR_DEFENCE_LINEAGE

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Conduct acceptance/operational tests against stakeholder expectations.

Problem it addressed

Validation occurs in a scripted environment with proxy users and misses workarounds, organisational fit, training, support or mission dynamics.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

The system is technically accepted but unusable, mistrusted or ineffective in operation.

Mechanism

Use representative users/operators, end-to-end mission threads, realistic environments and lifecycle support; capture divergence between test and field.

Trigger or context

Human-facing systems; new workflows; mission capability; autonomous/AI systems; complex operations.

Non trigger or cheap path

For a small direct-user service, observe actual use and incorporate rapid feedback rather than stage a formal validation event.

The property itself requires explicit evidence adequacy, coverage, uncertainty, residual limitations and currentness.

Known failure modes

Verifying the wrong baseline; unrepresentative environment; coverage-as-correctness; model reuse beyond validity; sign-off overclaim; ignored contradictory evidence.

Important criticisms

Operational tests can still be politically scripted, unrepresentative or too late; user preference is not the only system constraint.

P040 — Preserve evidence identity, coverage, limitations and anomalies
Property id

P040

Property name

Preserve evidence identity, coverage, limitations and anomalies

Historical origin

Verification compliance, configuration and discrepancy-control traditions.

Lineage class

VERIFICATION_VALIDATION_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Maintain verification status and test reports.

Problem it addressed

Pass/fail status is detached from configuration, environment, procedure, data, coverage, exceptions or unresolved anomalies.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

A green compliance matrix overstates what was actually shown.

Mechanism

Store the claim, method, configuration, environment, data provenance, result, coverage, limitations, reviewer/authority and anomalies as one evidence record.

Trigger or context

Certification, long lifecycle, reused tests, many variants, distributed test organisations.

Non trigger or cheap path

For low-risk work, a reproducible command, immutable result and concise limitation note may be enough.

Dependencies or preconditions

Explicit claims, authoritative baseline, fit-for-purpose environment/data, independent or competent evaluators and anomaly/limitation handling.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Validation claims require current intended use and representative stakeholders/operations.

Authority preconditions

Technical evidence authority, acceptance authority and need/mission authority must not be conflated.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Claim, item configuration, procedure/model/tool/data and environment must be fixed and recoverable.

Interface or integration preconditions

System and cross-boundary claims require composition evidence, not only component results.

Evidence or vv preconditions

The property itself requires explicit evidence adequacy, coverage, uncertainty, residual limitations and currentness.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: A green compliance matrix overstates what was actually shown. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Verifier, validator, qualification/certification authority, acceptance authority, architecture/change authority and operator.

Known failure modes

Verifying the wrong baseline; unrepresentative environment; coverage-as-correctness; model reuse beyond validity; sign-off overclaim; ignored contradictory evidence.

Important criticisms

Evidence records can become huge and inaccessible; metadata completeness can distract from weak discrimination.

How the property evolved

Original form: Maintain verification status and test reports. Evolved under criticism into: Evidence as a reproducible, bounded claim rather than a status cell or signed attachment.

Evolved form in this source

Evidence as a reproducible, bounded claim rather than a status cell or signed attachment.

Ceremony vs property

Compliance matrices, test reports and V-model diagrams are optional. The property is bounded evidence for a specified claim and use.

P041 — Establish model credibility for a specified intended use
Property id

P041

Property name

Establish model credibility for a specified intended use

Historical origin

Simulation V&V and NASA model-credibility standard lineage.

Lineage class

VERIFICATION_VALIDATION_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Verify and validate models before using them for engineering decisions.

Problem it addressed

A model validated for one purpose, domain or fidelity is treated as universally authoritative.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Decision risk is hidden behind impressive simulation output.

Mechanism

State intended use, decision consequence, referent, assumptions, uncertainty, verification, validation, input/data provenance, comparison evidence and permissible uses/caveats.

Trigger or context

Models replace or shape costly tests; autonomous systems; digital twins; safety/performance decisions.

Non trigger or cheap path

For low-consequence exploratory models, label them as exploratory and avoid formal credibility programmes.

Dependencies or preconditions

Explicit claims, authoritative baseline, fit-for-purpose environment/data, independent or competent evaluators and anomaly/limitation handling.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Validation claims require current intended use and representative stakeholders/operations.

Authority preconditions

Technical evidence authority, acceptance authority and need/mission authority must not be conflated.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Claim, item configuration, procedure/model/tool/data and environment must be fixed and recoverable.

System and cross-boundary claims require composition evidence, not only component results.

Evidence or vv preconditions

The property itself requires explicit evidence adequacy, coverage, uncertainty, residual limitations and currentness.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Decision risk is hidden behind impressive simulation output. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Verifier, validator, qualification/certification authority, acceptance authority, architecture/change authority and operator.

Known failure modes

Verifying the wrong baseline; unrepresentative environment; coverage-as-correctness; model reuse beyond validity; sign-off overclaim; ignored contradictory evidence.

Important criticisms

Credibility assessment can become expensive paperwork; physical validation data may be scarce or unavailable.

How the property evolved

Original form: Verify and validate models before using them for engineering decisions. Evolved under criticism into: Risk- and use-bounded model credibility with explicit prohibition against unsupported reuse.

Evolved form in this source

Risk- and use-bounded model credibility with explicit prohibition against unsupported reuse.

Ceremony vs property

Compliance matrices, test reports and V-model diagrams are optional. The property is bounded evidence for a specified claim and use.

P042 — Track technical performance, margins, reserves and trends for decisions
Property id

P042

Property name

Track technical performance, margins, reserves and trends for decisions

Historical origin

Aerospace budgets and technical-performance measurement.

Lineage class

AEROSPACE_OR_DEFENCE_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Allocate and monitor mass, power, cost, latency, reliability and other budgets against thresholds.

Problem it addressed

Point estimates hide erosion, uncertainty or cross-subsystem consumption until the system cannot close.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Teams report green current values while trends or margins make future failure likely.

Mechanism

Define decision-relevant measure, owner, allocation, uncertainty, threshold/objective, margin policy, trend and action trigger; reallocate transparently.

Trigger or context

Tightly constrained physical systems; shared resources; performance-sensitive architecture; long integration.

Non trigger or cheap path

Skip dashboards for unconstrained variables; track only measures that can change a decision.

Dependencies or preconditions

Authoritative objectives, measurable variables, causal understanding sufficient to select indicators and owners with authority to act.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Measures/risks must connect to mission or stakeholder outcomes and constraints.

Authority preconditions

Thresholds, reserve policy, risk acceptance and corrective-action authority must be named.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Measure definition, data source, configuration, time and uncertainty must be stable enough for comparison.

Interface or integration preconditions

Shared budgets and cross-boundary risks require allocation and integration visibility.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Measures and risk-retirement evidence need calibrated data, trend and uncertainty; scores alone are not evidence.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Teams report green current values while trends or margins make future failure likely. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Technical authority, architecture/programme decision makers, subsystem owners and risk acceptance authority.

Metric gaming; stale registers; ordinal-score arithmetic; point estimates; hidden correlations; reserve hoarding; no action consumer.

Budgets can be padded or gamed; aggregate margin may conceal local incompatibility; dashboard maintenance can become ceremony.

How the property evolved

A small, governed set of leading technical indicators with uncertainty and explicit response—not metric volume.

Ceremony vs property

Dashboards and risk registers are optional. The property is decision-bearing measurement, learning and contingency.

P043 — Link technical risk and uncertainty to learning and decisions
Property id

P043

Property name

Link technical risk and uncertainty to learning and decisions

Historical origin

Systems analysis, technical risk management and technology maturation.

Lineage class

HYBRID

Tradition relation

HYBRID_RESOLUTION

Original form

Maintain a technical risk register and mitigation plans.

Problem it addressed

Risks are listed and scored without changing architecture, experiments, reserves, sequencing or decisions.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

The register stays active while uncertainty remains untested and exposure silently grows.

Mechanism

Tie each material uncertainty to affected objective/decision, causal scenario, evidence gap, learning action, owner, trigger and residual exposure; update after tests/integration.

Trigger or context

Novel technology; uncertain environment; high consequence; architecture commitment; supplier dependency.

Non trigger or cheap path

For a cheap uncertainty, run the direct experiment instead of scoring it repeatedly.

Authoritative objectives, measurable variables, causal understanding sufficient to select indicators and owners with authority to act.

Measures/risks must connect to mission or stakeholder outcomes and constraints.

Shared budgets and cross-boundary risks require allocation and integration visibility.

Measures and risk-retirement evidence need calibrated data, trend and uncertainty; scores alone are not evidence.

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: The register stays active while uncertainty remains untested and exposure silently grows. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Technical authority, architecture/programme decision makers, subsystem owners and risk acceptance authority.

Known failure modes

Metric gaming; stale registers; ordinal-score arithmetic; point estimates; hidden correlations; reserve hoarding; no action consumer.

Important criticisms

Ordinal risk matrices create false precision; opportunity language can dilute serious exposure; unknown unknowns remain.

Original form: Maintain a technical risk register and mitigation plans. Evolved under criticism into: Risk as an executable learning/contingency plan integrated with decisions and technical evidence.

Dashboards and risk registers are optional. The property is decision-bearing measurement, learning and contingency.

P044 — Tailor systems-engineering depth to consequence, complexity, uncertainty and reversibility
Property id

P044

Property name

Tailor systems-engineering depth to consequence, complexity, uncertainty and reversibility

Historical origin

Lifecycle standards, defence pathway tailoring, agile SE and very-small-entity profiles.

Lineage class

HYBRID

Tradition relation

HYBRID_RESOLUTION

Original form

Tailor standard processes and artefacts to project size and lifecycle.

Problem it addressed

Full ceremony is imposed on cheap reversible work, or critical cross-boundary work is declared 'agile' and left without adequate evidence.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Engineering effort is either wasted or underpowered relative to actual risk.

Mechanism

Scale representation, authority, independence, traceability, modelling, review and V&V to consequence, coupling, novelty, distribution, irreversibility and evidence fragility; retain a documented cheap path.

Trigger or context

Every project; especially heterogeneous portfolios and mixed hardware/software.

Non trigger or cheap path

Local reversible work should use direct evidence, short records and immediate feedback unless a trigger appears.

Dependencies or preconditions

A transparent trigger model, authority to tailor, minimum non-waivable obligations and feedback on actual engineering outcomes.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Consequence and value are judged against current stakeholder/mission commitments.

Authority preconditions

Tailoring decisions require named authority and cannot be self-exemption by the work producer alone where consequence is high.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Applicable lifecycle, product, change and evidence scope must be identified.

Interface or integration preconditions

Coupling, organisational distribution and interface complexity are core escalation triggers.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Evidence fragility, consequence and reversibility determine review/V&V depth.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Engineering effort is either wasted or underpowered relative to actual risk. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Technical authority, project/product leadership, assurance authority and teams executing the cheap path.

Known failure modes

Blanket process; arbitrary waivers; size-only scaling; process accretion; inherited controls with no consumer; under-assurance under 'agile' labels.

Important criticisms

Tailoring can become arbitrary omission or negotiation by the most powerful team; standards offer little empirical calibration.

How the property evolved

Original form: Tailor standard processes and artefacts to project size and lifecycle. Evolved under criticism into: A trigger-based assurance architecture with explicit escalation and de-escalation, not project-size folklore or blanket waivers.

Evolved form in this source

A trigger-based assurance architecture with explicit escalation and de-escalation, not project-size folklore or blanket waivers.

Ceremony vs property

Tailoring matrices and plans are optional. The property is explicit activation/deactivation of engineering machinery by evidence-bearing triggers.

P045 — Engineer distributed authority and federated governance in systems of systems
Property id

P045

Property name

Engineer distributed authority and federated governance in systems of systems

Historical origin

Maier's SoS definition, DoD SoS guidance and ISO 21839.

Lineage class

SYSTEMS_OF_SYSTEMS_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Coordinate constituent-system managers under a SoS capability office.

Problem it addressed

A central architecture assumes authority it does not possess; constituents optimise local missions and schedules.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Global capability plans fail because dependencies cannot be compelled or synchronised.

Mechanism

Map real decision rights, incentives, commitments, escalation, voluntary standards and fallback options; design governance around managerial and operational independence.

Trigger or context

Constituent systems have independent ownership, resources, goals and lifecycle.

Non trigger or cheap path

Ordinary multi-team systems under one enforceable authority should use normal interface/configuration governance instead.

Dependencies or preconditions

Demonstrated operational and managerial independence, mission-level dependence, constituent identities, real authority map and communication mechanisms.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Global mission legitimacy and each constituent's local stakeholders/goals must both be represented.

Authority preconditions

Central authority limits, constituent sovereignty, incentives, agreements and escalation must be explicit.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Constituent versions, membership, compatibility and mission configurations change asynchronously and must be tracked.

Interface or integration preconditions

Interoperability spans technical, semantic, organisational and policy interfaces.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Mission-thread and runtime/operational evidence must supplement constituent verification.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Global capability plans fail because dependencies cannot be compelled or synchronised. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Mission/capability owner, constituent owners, interoperability/integration authorities and operators.

Known failure modes

Fictional central control; voluntary compliance without incentive; stale global architecture; local optimisation; asynchronous drift; untestable dynamic compositions.

Important criticisms

Governance frameworks often lack enforceable authority and can become coordination forums without consequence.

How the property evolved

Original form: Coordinate constituent-system managers under a SoS capability office. Evolved under criticism into: Federated governance that states where authority ends and uses incentives/contracts/evidence rather than fictional central control.

Evolved form in this source

Federated governance that states where authority ends and uses incentives/contracts/evidence rather than fictional central control.

Ceremony vs property

SoS boards and architecture frameworks are optional. The property is federated coordination under real independence and evolving composition.

P046 — Manage interoperability and asynchronous evolution across independent constituents
Property id

P046

Property name

Manage interoperability and asynchronous evolution across independent constituents

Historical origin

SoS architecting and interoperability research.

Lineage class

SYSTEMS_OF_SYSTEMS_LINEAGE

Tradition relation

SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_NATIVE

Original form

Publish common standards and manage SoS interfaces.

Problem it addressed

Constituents change on independent schedules, breaking semantics, performance or mission threads despite nominal standard compliance.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

The SoS capability degrades through composition drift no single owner can see.

Mechanism

Maintain capability-level dependency and compatibility views, versioned contracts, transition windows, monitoring, fallback modes and repeated mission-thread evidence.

Trigger or context

Operationally and managerially independent systems; coalition/federated networks; long-lived ecosystems.

Non trigger or cheap path

A centrally controlled system with synchronised releases does not trigger SoS machinery.

Dependencies or preconditions

Demonstrated operational and managerial independence, mission-level dependence, constituent identities, real authority map and communication mechanisms.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Global mission legitimacy and each constituent's local stakeholders/goals must both be represented.

Authority preconditions

Central authority limits, constituent sovereignty, incentives, agreements and escalation must be explicit.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Constituent versions, membership, compatibility and mission configurations change asynchronously and must be tracked.

Interface or integration preconditions

Interoperability spans technical, semantic, organisational and policy interfaces.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Mission-thread and runtime/operational evidence must supplement constituent verification.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: The SoS capability degrades through composition drift no single owner can see. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Mission/capability owner, constituent owners, interoperability/integration authorities and operators.

Known failure modes

Fictional central control; voluntary compliance without incentive; stale global architecture; local optimisation; asynchronous drift; untestable dynamic compositions.

Important criticisms

Global dependency models become stale; standards can ossify local innovation; constituents may not disclose changes.

How the property evolved

Original form: Publish common standards and manage SoS interfaces. Evolved under criticism into: Evolution-aware interoperability with graceful degradation and current evidence, not one-time standard adoption.

Evolved form in this source

Evolution-aware interoperability with graceful degradation and current evidence, not one-time standard adoption.

Ceremony vs property

SoS boards and architecture frameworks are optional. The property is federated coordination under real independence and evolving composition.

Lineage class

Original form

Replace document-centric SE with a coherent system model.

Problem it addressed

A large model is built because MBSE is mandated but does not improve analysis, coordination, change or V&V.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Model maintenance adds cost while real decisions continue in slides, spreadsheets and tacit knowledge.

Mechanism

Define model questions, users, decisions and generated evidence before modelling; choose scope/language/fidelity accordingly; measure use and retire unused views.

Trigger or context

High relationship density; repeated analysis; multiple viewpoints; automation/interchange opportunity; long lifecycle.

Non trigger or cheap path

For a simple project, structured text, tables, executable tests or sketches may be superior.

Dependencies or preconditions

Named model questions/consumers, governance, skilled users, versioning, tool/data access, validation and sustainable maintenance economics.

Models must represent authorised needs/use and disclose omitted stakeholders/context.

Authority is claim-specific; tool/repository ownership does not grant truth authority.

Interface or integration preconditions

Evidence or vv preconditions

Intended use, verification, validation, uncertainty, provenance, currentness and permissible inference are mandatory for consequential use.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Model maintenance adds cost while real decisions continue in slides, spreadsheets and tacit knowledge. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Engineers/analysts making decisions, integrators, V&V authorities, operators and lifecycle data users.

Known failure modes

Model volume; staleness; tool lock-in; inconsistent repositories; semantic loss; perceived-benefit bias; automated false coherence; inaccessible expertise.

Important criticisms

Systematic reviews find claimed benefits often perceived, adoption costly and metrics immature.

P048 — Federate models semantically and preserve representation portability
Property id

P048

Property name

Federate models semantically and preserve representation portability

Historical origin

Semantic interoperability, model federation and SysML/API standardisation.

Lineage class

MODEL_BASED_GENERALISATION

Tradition relation

MODEL_BASED_GENERALISATION

Original form

Exchange models among tools through common formats and maintain a model repository.

Problem it addressed

Tools exchange files or identifiers while meanings, constraints, behaviour and provenance are lost or transformed silently.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

A digital thread presents connected artefacts that are not semantically equivalent.

Mechanism

Define canonical semantics/ontologies where justified; test transformations; record losses; expose inconsistency; preserve export/API access and tool-exit paths.

Trigger or context

Multiple engineering disciplines/tools/suppliers; long-lived data; regulated handover; acquisition lock-in risk.

Non trigger or cheap path

One-team/one-tool short-lived work can use a stable open export and documented schema.

Dependencies or preconditions

Named model questions/consumers, governance, skilled users, versioning, tool/data access, validation and sustainable maintenance economics.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Models must represent authorised needs/use and disclose omitted stakeholders/context.

Authority preconditions

Authority is claim-specific; tool/repository ownership does not grant truth authority.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Model, metamodel, tool, data, transformation, implementation and physical referent versions must be related.

Interface or integration preconditions

Semantic interoperability, transformation loss, APIs and supplier/tool boundaries must be tested.

Evidence or vv preconditions

Intended use, verification, validation, uncertainty, provenance, currentness and permissible inference are mandatory for consequential use.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: A digital thread presents connected artefacts that are not semantically equivalent. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Engineers/analysts making decisions, integrators, V&V authorities, operators and lifecycle data users.

Known failure modes

Model volume; staleness; tool lock-in; inconsistent repositories; semantic loss; perceived-benefit bias; automated false coherence; inaccessible expertise.

Important criticisms

Universal ontologies are costly and politically contested; standards lag tools; strict consistency can impede parallel work.

How the property evolved

Original form: Exchange models among tools through common formats and maintain a model repository. Evolved under criticism into: Plural specialised models connected by tested semantic mappings and portable identities—not forced monolithic modelling.

Evolved form in this source

Plural specialised models connected by tested semantic mappings and portable identities—not forced monolithic modelling.

Ceremony vs property

SysML, repositories, digital threads and twins are optional technologies. The property is decision-relevant, credible, current and portable structured knowledge.

P050 — Reuse evidence only within explicit applicability boundaries
Property id

P050

Property name

Reuse evidence only within explicit applicability boundaries

Historical origin

Qualification-by-similarity, model reuse, regression and lifecycle evidence traditions.

Lineage class

HYBRID

Tradition relation

HYBRID_RESOLUTION

Original form

Credit prior analyses, tests and certifications for unchanged or similar products.

Problem it addressed

Historical evidence is copied to a new configuration, environment, user population or intended use without proving relevance.

Failure mode it tries to prevent

Reuse reduces cost on paper while silently importing invalid assumptions.

Mechanism

State the original claim/configuration/use; compare deltas and assumptions; justify equivalence; preserve residual gaps; invalidate and supplement where transfer is not established.

Trigger or context

Product families; software updates; supplier reuse; models; digital threads; certification-heavy domains.

Non trigger or cheap path

Rerun a cheap decisive test rather than writing an elaborate similarity argument.

Dependencies or preconditions

Explicit claims, authoritative baseline, fit-for-purpose environment/data, independent or competent evaluators and anomaly/limitation handling.

Stakeholder or mission preconditions

Validation claims require current intended use and representative stakeholders/operations.

Authority preconditions

Technical evidence authority, acceptance authority and need/mission authority must not be conflated.

Configuration or identity preconditions

Claim, item configuration, procedure/model/tool/data and environment must be fixed and recoverable.

Interface or integration preconditions

System and cross-boundary claims require composition evidence, not only component results.

Evidence or vv preconditions

The property itself requires explicit evidence adequacy, coverage, uncertainty, residual limitations and currentness.

Expected payoff asserted at this source scope

Reduces the probability, detection latency or consequence of: Reuse reduces cost on paper while silently importing invalid assumptions. It should also improve the quality or speed of the named decision consumer; otherwise it should be retired or simplified.

Decision or consumer

Verifier, validator, qualification/certification authority, acceptance authority, architecture/change authority and operator.

Known failure modes

Verifying the wrong baseline; unrepresentative environment; coverage-as-correctness; model reuse beyond validity; sign-off overclaim; ignored contradictory evidence.

Important criticisms

Equivalence arguments can be circular or optimistic; excessive conservatism destroys reuse value.

How the property evolved

Original form: Credit prior analyses, tests and certifications for unchanged or similar products. Evolved under criticism into: Evidence reuse as a bounded inference with explicit source identity, delta analysis and authority—not document inheritance.

Evolved form in this source

Evidence reuse as a bounded inference with explicit source identity, delta analysis and authority—not document inheritance.

Ceremony vs property

Compliance matrices, test reports and V-model diagrams are optional. The property is bounded evidence for a specified claim and use.
